label: preparing
what: Coordinated preparations for an undisclosed gathering in the great hall, plausibly linked to tomorrow's 18:00 innkeeper appointment with explicit instruction not to arrive early. Twenty-four loaves have been delivered and building supplies exchanged for grain. The exact occasion is unknown. Neighbour offered baking help and later carried a sack of bread; their precise involvement is less certain. Secretary reports and investigates these activities, but there is insufficient evidence they knowingly help prepare the undisclosed event.
